t_advice_summary_textbox.text: It is advisable to quickly choose gnome to collect mushrooms so as not to miss any opportunity to gain points. Ensure to notice the different color patterns and how they help in giving good number.

vb_textbox.text: Ensure to be fast enough when selecting your gnome and choosing to collect the mushrooms so as not to miss chances of accumulating points. Be observant of the patterns identify the color that could boost your points more. For instance, the green, blue and grey worked well for me
